data.name: aMAZE 3D
data.detailed_description:
aMAZE 3D is a relaxing yet challenging 3D maze puzzle game that combines classic labyrinth gameplay with colorful, space-inspired visuals and a calming soundtrack. Guide a small ball through intricate 3D mazes, explore winding pathways, and find your way to the red cube in this atmospheric collection of logic puzzles and brain teasers.

Enter a world of three-dimensional labyrinths where every turn brings a new challenge. Navigate branching paths, avoid dead ends, and use your logic, concentration, and spatial reasoning to discover the correct route. As you progress, the mazes become larger and more complex, putting your problem-solving skills, patience, and sense of direction to the test.

Whether you enjoy casual puzzle games, relaxing brain teasers, or challenging maze adventures, aMAZE 3D offers an enjoyable experience for players of different skill levels. Explore a variety of labyrinth layouts, discover new paths, and experience the timeless satisfaction of solving classic maze puzzles in a colorful 3D environment.

With its distinctive space-themed art, peaceful background music, and intuitive ball maze gameplay, aMAZE 3D delivers a relaxing yet rewarding single-player puzzle experience. Take your time, think carefully, and enjoy the journey through every labyrinth.

Key Features

  • 50 challenging levels – Explore increasingly complex 3D labyrinths that test your logic and navigation skills.

  • Classic 3D ball maze gameplay – Guide a ball through winding passages and reach the red cube to complete each maze.

  • Logic puzzles and brain teasers – Exercise your concentration, patience, and spatial thinking.

  • Colorful space-inspired visuals – Enjoy vibrant 3D graphics with a distinctive cosmic atmosphere.

  • Relaxing background music – Solve puzzles at your own pace with a calm and peaceful soundtrack.

  • Simple, intuitive controls – Navigate the mazes using WASD or the arrow keys.

  • 150 Steam Achievements – Complete levels and unlock achievements to decorate your Steam profile.

  • Steam Cloud support – Keep your game progress saved and synchronized across supported devices.

  • Steam Deck Verified – Enjoy the maze-solving experience on Steam Deck.

  • Family-friendly puzzle experience – Accessible gameplay for casual players and labyrinth enthusiasts alike.

Explore the labyrinths, challenge your mind, and find your way through the universe of aMAZE 3D!
